recognize_zh: 免疫染色中一群大型腫瘤細胞呈強烈的細胞質與膜陽性，部分有核旁點狀加強（Golgi 區），背景小細胞為陰性；依描述為 CD3 陽性的大細胞，對應 ALK 陽性未分化大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）。
features: Numerous large tumor cells with strong cytoplasmic and membranous positivity
Perinuclear/paranuclear dot-like accentuation in many cells (Golgi pattern)
Large, round to kidney-shaped nuclei visible as negative centers within stained cytoplasm
Cohesive-appearing sheet-like distribution of positive cells
Intervening negative background cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (reported as CD3) shows a dense population of large neoplastic cells with strong cytoplasmic and membranous staining, frequently with paranuclear Golgi-type accentuation, while intervening smaller background cells are negative. The positive cells have large round to reniform nuclei. CD3 is lost in a majority of ALK-positive ALCL, so positivity here is an uncommon but recognized finding; diagnosis rests on strong uniform CD30 and ALK expression. Findings support a T-cell lineage large cell lymphoma, consistent with the provided diagnosis of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphologically and CD30-identical, but lacks ALK protein expression and ALK rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: Shows more heterogeneous, weaker CD30 staining and lacks the uniform hallmark cell population and ALK expression.
Reed-Sternberg cells are CD15/PAX5 weakly positive, usually CD3 and EMA negative, and scattered in an inflammatory background rather than forming sheets.
Cohesive large cells in sinuses may mimic ALCL but express keratin or S100/SOX10 and lack T-cell markers and CD30/ALK.
